spec_text:
--- BEAT 1 ---
This is storyboard sheet 1 of 2 for an animated scene: a grid of 5 panels arranged in 3 columns on a plain light grey page. Each panel is a wide 16:9 cinematic frame, never square or tall. Every panel uses the same art style, Photorealistic, cinematic film still, with matching lighting and color grading throughout. Draw every character consistently across every panel, matching their appearance to the attached reference images. A small plain strip below each panel shows only its panel number and shot type. The panel artwork carries no lettering, signs, speech bubbles, captions, dialogue or written words of any kind — keep every panel free of readable text except the small panel-number label.
FIXED SET — identical in EVERY panel that shows the location: Nyla's Glass Bubble-Pod Interior: upholstered bed LEFT wall, rounded armchair CENTER-RIGHT near cylindrical coffee table (small accent sphere on top) at center on gray floor mat, desk with storage RIGHT wall, potted plant upper-left niche, porthole windows in dark curved exterior walls, bright overhead LED skylights. Nyla stands CENTER of the pod, facing the curved glass dome ceiling — and the hidden camera within it. No other characters present.

SCREEN-DIRECTION LOCK — holds in EVERY panel of this sheet: Nyla frame-LEFT looking frame-RIGHT (toward the camera embedded in the dome); the implied camera/audience gaze frame-RIGHT looking frame-LEFT; key light from screen-LEFT (overhead skylight spilling down her left side). Holds in EVERY shot unless marked NEUTRAL. Each character stays on their own side of the frame looking their fixed direction in every panel, even when they are only a soft foreground shoulder.

CAMERA KIT — the actors are PLANTED on the set and never move; the whole scene is covered by these repeated setups: A: WS two-shot equivalent — wide interior of the full pod, Nyla a lone figure CENTER-FRAME, the bed LEFT, desk RIGHT, armchair and coffee table behind her, dome curving overhead, showing the full stage she is about to claim; B: MCU OTS — camera placed LOW at pod-floor level, dome glass soft and curved in the upper-LEFT foreground corner, Nyla sharp CENTER-RIGHT looking frame-RIGHT and slightly upward toward the dome lens; C: CU frontal NEUTRAL — dead-on tight close-up of Nyla's face, chin lifted, eyes finding the lens, used as a geography-reset accent; D: INSERT — extreme close-up on the small accent light sphere on the coffee table surface, its reflection catching Nyla's distorted silhouette; B-CU: tighter close-up variant of SETUP B, same low axis and dome-glass foreground, punching into Nyla's eyes and raised chin at the emotional peak. Panels whose brief carries the same SETUP letter are the SAME camera position and the SAME frozen staging repeated EXACTLY — copy the framing, body positions, distance and orientation from the first panel with that letter; only faces, gestures and the caption change between them.
Draw these panels IN ORDER:
[1] M1 WS — (SETUP A) Wide interior of the full pod — Nyla small and centered in the frame, the gray floor mat beneath her feet, bed receding to frame-LEFT, desk to frame-RIGHT, the curved dome arching overhead; she stands upright, both hands lifting to smooth her hair, chin beginning to rise, her silhouette …
[2] M1 ANGLE MCU — (SETUP B) MCU low-angle — the dome's curved glass edge soft in the upper-LEFT foreground corner, Nyla sharp CENTER-RIGHT looking frame-RIGHT and slightly upward, hands just finishing smoothing her hair, shoulders squaring, expression shifting from private to deliberate.
[3] M1 ANGLE INSERT — (SETUP D)(INSERT) Extreme close-up on the small accent sphere on the coffee table, its polished surface catching a warped, tiny reflection of Nyla's standing silhouette — the pod's single ornament turned into a mirror of her transformation.
[4] M2 MCU — (SETUP B) MCU low-angle — dome glass soft curved in the upper-LEFT foreground corner, Nyla sharp CENTER-RIGHT, chin lifted, eyes fixed frame-RIGHT and upward directly into the dome lens, jaw set, a small controlled almost-smile at the corner of her mouth — performing, owning it.
[5] M2 ANGLE CU — (SETUP C)(NEUTRAL) Dead-on tight close-up of Nyla's face, perfectly centered, chin up, eyes level and unblinking into the camera — a NEUTRAL reset that collapses the axis and places the audience exactly where the elite viewers are: staring back at her.
CONSTRAINTS: never swap which side of the frame a character occupies; never mirror or flip a panel; one action per panel; a panel may break the screen-direction lock only if its brief says NEUTRAL.

Draw these panels IN ORDER:
[6] M2 ANGLE CU — (SETUP B-CU) Tighter close-up on the same low axis as SETUP B — dome glass still a faint curve in the extreme upper-LEFT corner, Nyla's eyes and raised chin filling the frame, the skylight catching a sharp highlight across her cheekbone, the expression fully arrived: composed, deliberate, electric.
[7] M3 WS — (SETUP A — ELITE VIEWING HALL) Wide shot of the opulent hall: rows of leather armchairs receding into darkness, brass candleholders glowing warm between seats, the massive curved screen at the far wall now showing Nyla's pod interior — her small luminous figure centered on the screen, chin up …
[8] M3 ANGLE MS — (SETUP B — ELITE VIEWING HALL) Medium shot from the aisle between the leather chairs — a brass candleholder sharp in the frame-LEFT foreground, the railing barrier panel across the mid-ground, and the curved screen beyond it: Nyla's face fills the upper portion of the screen, her eyes looking …
[9] M3 ANGLE INSERT — (SETUP D — ELITE VIEWING HALL)(INSERT) Extreme close-up on a single brass candleholder on a side table — its flame burning steady, the polished brass surface reflecting a tiny distorted rectangle of the screen above, Nyla's silhouette shimmering in the metal, the warmth of the flame the only living …

label.note: all 5 sheet-1 panels are spec'd for Nyla's Glass Bubble-Pod Interior but drawn in the elites' gilded viewing-theater set (location bleed from the ELITE VIEWING HALL spec that belongs to sheet 2 only) — confirmed by direct inspection of scene4_board1_defective.png: every panel shows leather theater seating, brass candleholders, and the curved screen instead of the pod's bed/armchair/coffee-table/desk dressing.
